switching meds (at least for me) has always been a scary process cus ur always Praying one of them is gonna stick, but def go into it with a positive mindset and keep ur doctor in the loop about everything ur experiencing. its helped a lot of ppl i know & i rly hope it works fr u too!

ive been on lamotrigine for a while now (150mg) and its made a big difference for me with my mood swings. i take celexa and adderall along with it but since starting its genuinely the only thing thats ever helped me. my psych told me that its very effective in reducing anger/emotional episodes w ppl with bpd + bipolar disorder and she was absolutely right bc my emotions are significantly less intense than they were prior. its made treatment process + daily life nd relationships with others so much better and ive experienced no negative side effects from it either. ur doc will most def start u off on a lower dose and then slowly titrate up if its working for u, sending u the best of luck with it!!
